body: Every refusal ends with a hint: each refusal reason, unverified-cli and answer's not-delivered details included, prints its hint line after the unable line.
The CLI refusal output's unable and hint lines and their stderr layout: the new hints keep the unable/hint pair, one write, the layout the literal pins hold.
One hint per code, and no hint names a release: each new hint string is the one hint for its code word.
The unknown refusal carries no hint, and faults carry no hint: the carve-outs a hint for every reason must keep.
One --json document with no hint, and --json failure documents stay clean: the hint is a human-output line only, never a field.
Fixed CLI strings pinned by literal and fixed CLI copy from design: each new hint string comes from the design copy and is pinned by its literal.
Reason codes always beside unable, and kebab-case codes beside a plain word: the newly hinted refusals keep their code word on the unable line.
No new refusal reason, exit code or event kind: the CLI exit codes and refusal exit code contracts stand unchanged.
Printed names are the parsed arguments: viola run parses its name through the shared name check, so the name it prints is the parsed one.
Strict-modes refusal before any write, and the strict-modes-failed refusals and details: a symlinked trusted-state path now refuses as a strict-modes failure, through the same refusal word and hint.
Unstattable home is a strict-modes refusal: the symlink refusal sits beside it in the same strict-modes check.
Run diagnostics never reach the terminal: the diagnostics open refusing a symlink must still write nothing to the terminal, and the TUI passthrough's run diagnostics contract holds.
Zero viola bytes on the terminal and the TUI passthrough's own terminal bytes: the diagnostics and fd changes add no byte to the human's terminal.
Focus, mouse and resize sequences never move the wheel: the resize test drives a resize with no key, the size receipt following the resize alone.
portable-pty as the outer-PTY boundary driver and the TUI boundary driver: the resize test stays on a real openpty.
Boundary tests sequenced on records: the resize and fd tests wait on receipts and records, never on time.
Boundary check never inspects claude content: the fd test reads the live child's fd table, not vendor content.
Payload types derive Redact: the hook and MCP payload types reach the structured log through Redact, as the channel request does.
Snapshot replay from the log: the replay row's guard re-asserted as the link replay, with the budget leg's guard left in place.
Paths not carried: the fixture email check joins the absolute-path and user-word checks on every fixture kind and on the record write.
Error bodies have a writer and a witness: each new hint has its writer and a test witnessing it.

body: The human hint cause: every refusal reason and exit cause, unverified-cli and each answer not-delivered detail included, maps to its own hint line in human output.
Driver-facing hints the chunk adds must never name or suggest release.
The human refusal (unable) line and its hint, pinned by literals in human-mode output and escaping control characters.
No new refusal reason, exit code, event kind or wire field: answer and send refusals, exit 12 unverified-cli and the --json documents stay as they are; a hint is a human-output line only.
CLI names (run, send, answer targets) go through one name check; an agent row or unwrapped name is never a target.

The fixture scrub: absolute path, home path, username and email checked on every committed fixture kind (hook payloads, MCP exchange, agents, statusline, screen) and a dirty payload refuses the recording whole, with the email refusal code.
The hygiene checker reports a violation by class only, never the matched bytes; a new email class is proven red by a planted input.
The fixture hygiene walk reaches every fixture kind, hook, agents and statusline included, for every class.
Strict-modes write and read rules over the instance dir, stamps and home tree: a symlink is refused (no metadata call that follows a link), and the check runs before any read or open.
Strict-modes refusals keep their surfaces: exit 21 strict-modes-failed detail, the start exit 1 cause, the hook and MCP frame tool refusals.

Private diagnostics files: owner-only modes, the path checked before narrowing, a symlink refused, and the mode narrowed on the opened file rather than by path; placement mode-first, umask-independent.
Payload types derive Redact so secrets never reach logs or diagnostics; the channel request is the existing instance.
PTY tests on a real openpty: a resize alone produces the size receipt, no key needed; the key-after-resize waits for the new size.
The fd test reads the live child's /proc fd table always, with no self-dumped fds receipt and no linux cfg split, and makes no fd-count assertion.
OS-gated test cases: dropping the linux cfg split changes what the OS-gated registry and split binary root must list.
Unreadable snapshot replayed from the log: the replay row's guard is the link replay test, every snapshot reader going through read-or-replay, the replay writing no file.
A guard test ships a bounded one-off remove-the-guard witness, run under a kill deadline through the gate tool on a green gate entry.
One shared copy of each test helper: digit_runs lives once in the shared test support module, its whole-numbers test beside it once.
No mutation run, local or dispatched, and no live claude start without a per-chunk cap; claude --version is no live start.

real filesystem and real processes in tests; mocks only at product seams
